concept: Cordova is one of the few grids where you can actually GRADE a forecast, because an islanded run-of-river system settles every wrong guess in gallons of diesel. A federal AI award arrives to build a digital twin of that grid, and the film's job is to name the measurement that would settle whether it worked, while being honest that the clever thing in the powerhouse was already there and somebody else put it there.

divergence_note: The last four dispatches ran pov cross-section-cutaway, orbital-aerial, exploded-diagram and eye-level-immersive, layout grid-modular, stacked-layers and fullbleed-split, and motion horizontal-traverse, vertical-descent and assemble-build, so all three signature axes here are unused inside the window: macro-closeup, single-object-void and radial-emanate. hero_treatment breaks a three-run run of instrument-as-subject by casting a single organic hero, Sourdough, who has never led this channel. The light story is the sharpest break: the last two films were bright light-field pieces on pale grounds, a warm paper interior on cream and a blue-and-white lab on off-white, and this one is night-practical, a dark wet exterior and a lamplit interior whose ground value is the darkest this channel has shipped in a month. The palette is built as an argument rather than a mood, amber always meaning measured and cyan always meaning claimed, which no previous dispatch has done.
